decode.sf: value*0.1 mm water equivalent of snowfall per month
decode.sde: value*0.1 cm mean snow depth on the ground

sources.tasmin,tasmax: CHELSA V2.1 1981-2010 monthly mean (tas) minus / plus half the day-night range of CRU CL 2.0 (New et al. 2002, period centred on 1961-1990; scripts/temprange_cru.py); nearest CRU cell within 50 km; else the nearest NOAA GHCN-Daily station within 50 km (its 1981-2010 TMAX-TMIN range); else missing (remote islands, most of Antarctica)
sources.d2m: ERA5-Land monthly means 1981-2010 (CC BY 4.0; contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information)
sources.sun: CRU CL 2.0 (New et al. 2002), period centred on 1961-1990, percent of possible sunshine converted to hours
sources.sun fallback: nearest CRU CL 2.0 cell within 50 km where the square has no cell (header field 17 = km)
sources.d2m fallback: ERA5 0.25-degree monthly means 1981-2010 (CC BY 4.0) where ERA5-Land has no value (header field 18 = 1)
sources.sf,sde: ERA5-Land monthly means 1981-2010 (CC BY 4.0); nearest cell within 50 km where the square has none (header field 19 = km)
sources.sf correction: snowfall terrain-height correction (scripts/snow_terrain_correction.py, variant chelsa): CHELSA precipitation x ERA5 snow share at the area's CHELSA temperature x ERA5 local residual; graded against held-out GHCN-Daily stations
